body:
Map name: Contagium
Creator:  c4ooo
Gamemode: DTM
Download link: https://sites.google.com/site/thekuznetsovproject/testing/Contagium.zip?attredirects=0&d=1
YML: TODO
DISCRIPTION: 
This map is supposed to be unique, and it accomplishes that in menay ways. This map is built for bow combat, with less space to PVP, and with uniquely placed "skybrides". There are diamonds in the middle, but do to the booby-traps they get blown up, as well as any of those brave to attempt to attain them. Each side has a practically infinite supply of gold, as well as some iron (5 sets), but more iron can be found on island in the middle of the map. Each of the 5 monuments has its own difficulty, owning to the fact that the left and right side of the map are not symmetrical. But here are the pics:

replies.author: hpux
replies.body: You're going to need to make the island shapes a lot less blocky. There's a lot of squares and rectangles. Also, I'd recommend moving the sides a bit farther from each other, and making them somewhat level. The color palette needs some improvement, you need some more block variation for the aesthetics. In addition, if possible, move the monuments a bit further back. This has potential, however. Good luck! :)
